note: SOURCES: composers' own work pages (Gordon, Wolfe, Lang, Luther Adams, Torke; Editions 75 for Johnson), Wikipedia work lists, IMSLP API for the Rzewski pages, and Deezer album/track pages (album ids in sources; timings are from them). MusicBrainz work lists were used for discovery only. OWNER RULINGS NEEDED: (1) Reich's Octet (1979) and Adams's Shaker Loops for string septet (1978) are recorded (ECM 1980; Analekta 2011) but the composers withdrew them; both skipped. (2) Low-confidence entries the owner may drop: Rzewski Piano Trio and Words (a premiere noted on IMSLP/press only), Riley's String Quartet, String Trio and Mythic Birds Waltz, Glass Quartet Satz. (3) Wikipedia and the composers' pages disagree on some facts: Gordon's Four Kings Fight Five is nine players on the publisher's page (Wikipedia lists seven); Potassium is 2000 on the publisher's page (2001 on Wikipedia); Glass String Quartet No. 9 is dated 2021 from its January 2022 recording (Wikipedia 2022); Rzewski's Whangdoodles has a hammer dulcimer on Wikipedia, percussion on IMSLP. VIOLIN CATALOGUE: none of the five cross-list candidates is in scope: Echorus 462 and Duet 532 are string orchestra, Apophthegms 600 is two violins, Violin Phase 1172 is one violin with tape or four violins, Tree-oh 4479 is for three violins (the catalogue says 'small ensemble'); Tinge 4478 and Idle 4477 are three violins. Glass's Pendulum 4474 is for violin and piano (no piano-trio version found). No violin_id is set. LEFT OUT ON PURPOSE: Zorn's Masada String Trio and Bar Kokhba albums (jazz groups playing Masada tunes, not discrete works), joint works of Gordon, Lang and Wolfe (Road Trip, Cloud River Mountain), and vocal pieces with fewer than three instruments. Pipa (Riley's The Cusp of Magic) is entered as lute; the sustaining keyboard in Luther Adams's pieces as piano; Torke's October is on his own label. NOT CHECKED: Muhly's Speaks Volumes pieces, Zorn's ensemble albums, Riley's other Kronos pieces, Glass's Music from The Screens (scorings not found).
